msg: hey!! im at a lil hotel on isla grande rn, certified diver but havent dived in like 4 yrs lol. can i go tmrw afternoon? how much
reply:
Hi! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. So happy to have you here! I'd love to help you put your plan together. 🌊

Diving in the Rosario Islands is a lovely way to get back underwater. Since it’s been 4 years, a refresher is normally required; it’s booked as the Dive Mini Course. The online price from the islands is **134 USD / 475,000 COP**.

The activity ends around 12:00–1:00 p.m., so an afternoon dive isn’t available. You can book for tomorrow through the link, before 4:30 p.m. the day before: https://book.divingplanet.org/book/dive-mini-course-already-on-island/20?language=en

If you’ve already completed a refresher or PADI ReActivate at another center, that counts and you can dive directly.

From the islands we coordinate pick-up and drop-off at your hotel if it has maritime access, or at the nearest dock we point you to.

Would you like the link for the certified-diver dives instead?

msg: ok cool its hotel sol y mar, does it have boat access?? book me for the dive + refresher tmrw morning then
reply:
I can’t confirm whether Hotel Sol y Mar has boat access from the information I have. If it does, pick-up is between 9:30 and 9:45 a.m.; otherwise, the team will indicate the nearest meeting point. The refresher is booked as the Dive Mini Course, and I can’t place or confirm the booking here. Tomorrow’s online booking cutoff is 4:30 p.m. today, so you can book through this link: https://book.divingplanet.org/book/dive-mini-course-already-on-island/20?language=en

If you're already on the Rosario Islands and your hotel has maritime access, boat pick-up and drop-off are included at no extra charge.

If you are already on the Rosario Islands, we coordinate pick-up and drop-off from hotels with maritime access. In some cases the boat arrives directly at the hotel; in others we indicate the nearest dock or meeting point.

And how many people should I plan for? That way I can give you the exact price. 😊
